# Ballast

> Ballast Research LLC is a research, development and media distribution company in Los Angeles. We find what sells, put the money behind it, and keep the customers it brings. We run paid media, creative, creator programs and measurement for brands in health and telehealth, sports, streaming and entertainment, retail and open finance.

## Results we can state
- $2M+ a month in peak managed ad spend at 4x blended ROAS (Toyota, Starbucks, STARZPLAY)
- 6.5x blended ROAS at peak spend
- $1.2M+ in monthly sales for a telehealth brand
- 30+ UGC creators onboarded and paid on sales
- $5K a day in sales from TikTok LIVE selling
- Paid media, creative and distribution for Netflix, Disney, Peacock, Universal, STARZPLAY, Starbucks, Toyota, LG, BMW, NEAR and SailGP

## Services
- Media strategy and planning: annual, quarterly and in-flight plans tied to sales and brand goals
- Paid media execution across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, programmatic and CTV, reported against revenue
- Live shopping: TikTok LIVE selling, including the shop, hosts, offers and schedule
- UGC and creator campaigns: creators recruited, briefed and paid on sales
- Measurement: one number per goal, reconciled to real orders, with tests that show what spend creates
- Creative: ads, product imagery and AI production made for each platform and built to pass review
- Regulated categories: health, telehealth, weight loss, supplements and open finance, with compliance built into accounts and creative
- Agency and team oversight: agencies, creators and vendors held to scope, cost and results
- Audience research: who buys, where demand exists and what moves them, including fans and creators in sport

## Pricing
From $3.5K to $100K depending on scope. An audit or a two-week sprint sits at the low end; ongoing media and creative run higher. Clients keep everything we build.
